research_question: Can the quarter-hour opening-flow episode be routed causally into short-horizon inventory reversion versus medium-horizon public-state delivery with enough after-cost expectancy and independent frequency to justify a frozen NautilusTrader scenario family?

hypothesis.event: The first completed minute beginning at each UTC quarter-hour is an execution-wave observation, not an entry reason by itself.
hypothesis.reversion: Extreme opening aggressor imbalance may reverse over the next 30 minutes when the prior public state does not support delivery.
hypothesis.delivery: When prior-only public price-volume state predicts the same 8-12 hour direction as opening aggressor imbalance, the episode may deliver in that direction over an eight-hour intraday leg.
hypothesis.unresolved: Routes with non-positive prior calibration expectancy, disagreement, stale training, funding settlement, or insufficient score fail closed.

QH_INVENTORY_REVERSION_30M.condition: predicted 30m return opposes current opening aggressor imbalance

QH_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_8H.condition: prior public 8h and 12h predictions agree and opening aggressor imbalance aligns

portfolio_diagnostic.same_event_arbitration: maximum prior-calibrated expected net edge, then score, then symbol
portfolio_diagnostic.overlap_policy: no new episode before the selected route horizon is complete
portfolio_diagnostic.independence: one selected route per quarter-hour causal episode

decision_contract.advance: Only a predeclared route/router passing development and untouched evaluation economics and frequency may be frozen for NautilusTrader implementation.
decision_contract.reject: If the router fails, do not threshold-tune this quarter-hour family; preserve only any independently positive route and move to a different causal scenario.
